correctness.rationale: With equal capacities and source-local C_ij=δ_ij, the primary model's Eq. (9) indeed collapses to (aI+fL)^{−1} in the symmetric weighted case, and its strict invasion test uses the spectral radius after multiplication by B=diag(c_i/e_i). The assumption is fixed C=I in the reduced model, not a generic f-dependent birth factor. Put t=1/f; on constants the inverse is 1/a, and on the mean-zero space each resolvent eigenvalue is t/(λ+a t)=t/λ+O(t²) with λ>0. Thus K_f B extends analytically at t=0 with rank-one leading matrix 1 b^T/(na) and nonzero isolated eigenvalue s/(na). Its left and right eigenvectors can be b^T and 1, pairing to s; the eigenvalue derivative is b^T L^+ b/s. The Perron branch at large f is this eigenvalue, since the remaining spectrum tends to zero and the positive kernel is irreducible. The energy is zero only for constant b, when row sums give the exact factor b_i/a. Multiplying by the eventually positive h_f gives coefficient Q_G−η; the strict alternatives follow at fixed graph, and the equality case is not claimed. Fix r=b−(s/n)1; on the mean-zero space ∂L/∂w_uv=(e_u−e_v)(e_u−e_v)^T, so differentiating the inverse gives ∂(r^TL^+r)/∂w_uv=−(φ_u−φ_v)^2. This is a conductance derivative on the connected domain. For exact finite replay, form H=aI+fL from unit path and triangle edges and subtract (49/50)diag(3,2,1) with a=2 and f=10. The leading minors are (453/50, 101953/1250, −448897/62500) and (953/50, 352453/1250, 1053103/62500), respectively. Congruence by H^{−1/2} turns H−hB into I−hH^{−1/2}BH^{−1/2}, giving strict invasion on the path and strict non-invasion on the triangle. Solving Lφ=(1,0,−1)^T with zero mean gives the respective potentials (1,0,−1)^T and (1/3,0,−1/3)^T, energies 2 and 2/3, and Q values 1/3 and 1/9, straddling 1/5. These were reproduced by exact rational determinant and mean-zero linear solves. The archived verifier was inspected, not executed, and the finite witness does not prove the general expansion. This is a fixed-graph deterministic linear threshold under the stated reduction, not a stochastic survival or uniform large-network result.

evidence: Bernardi et al. Eq. (11) resolves the exact kernel into Laplacian eigenmodes and §II.B mentions same-patch explorer birth; Theorem 1 gives the Perron test. The coefficient here uses the first variation of the Perron root at the rank-one limit, not merely a kernel-entry expansion. It becomes b^TL^+b/s after applying the correct left/right normalization.

In the 2023 model the kernel includes an adjacency birth factor and h(f); adding a corridor changes that factor as well as the dispersal operator. The reported benefits of adding connectivity therefore do not imply this window or contradict the reversal under fixed C=I.
The qualitative reduction/mean limit does not compare η to the graph-dependent coefficient and hence does not imply the claimed strict sign when the leading margin is itself O(f^{−1}).

evidence: Writing H=aI+fL, the exact threshold is hρ(H^{−1}B)>1 if and only if λ_max(hB−fL)>a; equivalently 1/ρ is the minimum eigenvalue of B^{−1/2}HB^{−1/2}. The first formulation puts the comparison in the additive diffusion/reduction literature, not just the resolvent literature.

The energy r^TL^+r also equals −½Σ_{i,j}r_i r_j R_eff(i,j) since Σ_i r_i=0. Known effective-resistance identities are therefore the same electrical object; the claim is the coefficient with which it enters the invasion threshold.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: These exact alias reductions separate already known monotonicity and resistance formulas from the evaluated inverse-mobility coefficient. At fixed f, adding a conductance increases H in Loewner order, which already yields qualitative nonincrease of ρ through B^{1/2}H^{−1}B^{1/2}; the numerical comparison alone is not the discovery.

originality.rationale: The birth-resolvent kernel and Perron criterion are prior; qualitative dispersal reduction, electrical inverse differentiation and eigenvalue perturbation are not contributions. The surviving quantitative claim is the evaluated electrical energy coefficient for this source-local kernel and its use in a sharp common-recruitment window. The checked primary kernel and spectral reduction results do not state or mechanically specialize to this coefficient and window; they require evaluating a different sensitivity. The exact same-parameter path/triangle witness illustrates that boundary rather than constituting a separate priority claim.
residual_risks: The Nicoletti supplementary PDF and final publisher version of the Chen paper were not read; the checked Chen theorem statements come from the open preprint. Earlier diffusion asymptotic or electrical-network literature could contain an equivalent coefficient in another normalization; bounded search is not exhaustive.

The same-rate comparison is only for fixed source-local birth and equal capacities. A colonization feasibility factor with its own 1/f dependence must be included separately; an adjacency-dependent choice changes the model. The critical equality case η=Q_G is outside the claim.

value.rationale: At infinite exploration the leading average cannot distinguish connected habitat geometries. The correction identifies exactly the structural quantity that decides invasion at the first unresolved recruitment scale. The conductance derivative says when a corridor changes that coefficient strictly, and the rational witness separates the two strict outcomes without confounding local recruitment rates; no ecological field or stochastic-survival claim follows.
